originals.why: Natural as a North Welsh reply to 'wyt ti'n barod?'. yndw is used in the same sense this course teaches.

originals.ko: 응, 나는 지금 갈 준비가 됐어, 정말 고마워
originals.why: Natural reply. yndw is used correctly as 'yes (I am)'.
Natural reply. yndw is used correctly as 'yes (I am)'.

topups.why: A bare 'ond yndw' is weak, and '하지만 응' is unnatural Korean.
'ond yndw, dw i wedi blino' is an awkward Welsh pairing, and the Korean is unnatural.

topups.ko: 응, 왜냐하면 나는 웨일스어를 배우고 싶거든

topups.why: Present-tense yndw followed by a future clause is awkward, and better candidates are available.
'ond yndw' at the start of the sentence is unnatural.
Present-tense yndw followed by a past negative 'do'n i ddim yn disgwyl o' is incoherent.
'yndw' followed by 'does dim ots gen i' does not answer a matching question naturally, so it is weak.

originals.ko: 그건 지금 큰 도움이 될 거야
하지만 그건 오늘 저녁에 큰 도움이 될 거야
물론 그건 큰 도움이 될 거야, 정말 고마워
나는 그게 큰 도움이 될지 확실하지 않아
그는 그게 다음 주에 큰 도움이 될 거라고 말했어
너는 그게 큰 도움이 될 거라고 생각해?
originals.why: 'wyt ti'n meddwl fyddai hynna'n help mawr?' is natural, idiomatic North Welsh, and it uses 'wyt ti'n meddwl' in the sense this course taught.

originals.ko: 그건 큰 도움이 될 거야, 왜냐하면 나는 시간이 조금 더 필요하거든

refill.why: Good phrase, but only one USE slot was needed and U01 is the better fit.
Acceptable, but only one USE slot was needed and U01 is cleaner.
Its Korean puts the reason first, the reverse of the Welsh, and the double 'i' in 'liciwn i i ti' reads awkwardly; only one slot was needed anyway.
'pnawn fory' tacked onto 'fyddai hynna'n help mawr' is an odd, unnatural pairing.
